what_this_is: The Workshop rows for the tools in tools/where-a-person-stands: what each tool does, what it takes and gives back, how it runs, and the stance record it keeps.

payload.label: Keep where you stand on something
payload.job: Write down whether a person agrees, disagrees or partly agrees with something made for them, such as a title, a take, a plan or a file, in their own words
payload.description: Give artifact_ref (the thing's identity: 1f: and 64 hex digits, or file: and that identity), stance (agree, disagree or partly, or null to take a stand back), why (the person's own words, kept exactly) and answered_by "person": only send what the person said. Returns the stance record, which is kept in the person's records as one record per thing (stance:<identity>), so a change of mind is a new version and every earlier stand stays in its history. A name instead of an identity, or a stand not answered by the person, is refused.

artifact_ref.description: The identity of the thing the stand is on

stance.description: Where the person stands; null takes the stand back

why.description: The person's own words, exactly as they said them

answered_by.description: Always person: a stand is only ever theirs

by.description: Who sent it (the app or chat), when it is not the person's own screen

at.description: When they said it, as an ISO time (default: now)

provenance.source: the record-stance owner of the decision engine, as a tool: the stand is a record, its history is the record's versions

payload.label: Read where you stand on things
payload.job: See whether a person agrees, disagrees or partly agrees with each thing made for them, in their own words, with every time they changed their mind
payload.description: Give records: the versions of the person's stance records (stance:<identity>) as their records keep them, in any order, and optionally artifact_ref for one thing. Returns stances: for each thing its stand now (the newest version), said, why in the person's own words, by, at, and earlier, every stand before it, oldest first; and choices, the stands a person can take. A thing with no stand, or whose stand was taken back, reads stance null: silence is not agreement.

records.description: The versions of the stance records, each the record value or { value }

artifact_ref.description: Optional: only the stand on this thing

provenance.source: the record-stance owner of the decision engine, as a tool: the stand is a record, its history is the record's versions
